scenes.narration_en: Near midnight, around 11:30 p.m., rain hammered Hai Yen Port on Thanh Lam Street. Between the containers lay Trinh Quang Vu, director of Sao Bien Shipping, dead.
A fatal wound to the back of his neck. The person who found him was Dang Thu Ha, his chief accountant, back for the ledgers.
She called the police, her voice cracking as she described a figure in a dark jacket sprinting through the port gate into the rain. Who was that figure?
